retrieval.rag_summary: Acoustica accessories comprise specialised companion components such as reinforced aluminium foil sealing tapes and acoustic adhesives engineered to seal joints in acoustic barriers, underlays, and pipe lagging systems. These accessories ensure airtight, gap-free perimeter and seam closures, eliminating acoustic flanking paths that would otherwise degrade sound transmission loss. Typically used across ceilings, walls, subfloors, and services piping, they are essential for achieving rated acoustic performance in residential and commercial soundproofing systems.
